description: A strip marker removes a run mixing spaces, tabs, newlines and Unicode spaces
notes: The spec says strip markers remove spaces, "interpreted as per Unicode's definition", without saying which definition it means. The run mixes spaces, a tab, the ideographic space U+3000, an escaped line feed and the no-break space U+00A0; only U+0020 is in every candidate definition, since the tab and line feed are not space separators (category Zs) and U+3000 and U+00A0 are not in Pattern_White_Space. Stripping them all is hashicorp/hcl's reading: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go trims with Go's unicode.IsSpace, which follows the White_Space property. The spec also doesn't say whether escape sequences are decoded before stripping; hashicorp/hcl decodes them first, calling ParseStringLiteralToken before it trims.
